Iron_Cross: Use a light dumbbell: this move reaches far from your body.
Keep your core braced and move under control through every rep.
Stop the set if your form breaks down or anything hurts.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Swings: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and hold the kettlebell in one hand.
Push your hips back, then drive them forward to swing the bell up to about chest height. The hips and legs do the work, not the arm.
Keep your back flat and your core braced, and let the bell swing back between your legs.
Push_Press: Start with the bar at shoulder height and your feet about shoulder width apart.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, then drive up with your legs and press the bar overhead.
Finish with the bar over the middle of your feet, then lower it to your shoulders with control.
Side_Bridge: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and your feet stacked.
Lift your hips so your body makes one straight line from head to feet.
Hold the position, breathe steadily, and lower with control. Repeat on the other side.
Side_Jackknife: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your hand behind your head.
Lift your top leg and your upper body toward each other.
Lower with control, and finish your reps on one side before switching.
